discordPostHtml:
Ever feel like your Luddic faithful are just too picky? Worlds that are harsh, polluted, or missing a few farms shouldn’t ruin a colony’s harmony?

This mod lets your Luddic populations tolerate things they normally wouldn’t:

Harsh or uninhabitable worlds? They’ll make do.

Dardan Kato’s policies trying to suppress them? Not a problem anymore.

Pick what the faithful will tolerate. Keep it subtle, or disable the Heavy Industry factor entirely if you want them to ignore all industrial hubs.

Thanks to LunaLib integration, you can tweak which negating factors are enforced - or turn them all off if you want the faithful to just… get along with everything.

Your colonies, your rules, your Luddic faithful thriving despite all the things that normally wouldn’t fly.

DOWNLOAD: https://github.com/exon-farer/Tolerant.LuddicMajority/releases/latest/download/Tolerant.LuddicMajority.zip
